positions.description: Skills: Java · JavaScript · Gitlab · React.js · Git · Python (Programming Language) · GitHub · C++ · Full-Stack Development · Bash · Node.js · HTML · Bootstrap (Framework) · Css · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · REST APIs · Model-View-Controller (MVC)

positions.title: Solutions Specialist
positions.description:
-Achieved top sales in district in not only quantity but revenue percentage as well
-Achieved highest revenue percentage in district multiple times
-Consistently top sales in store
-Consistently double and exceed quota

positions.title: Sales Consultant
positions.description:
-Achieved Top sales rep in store first month and second month selling
-Responsible for the meet and greet, and sales of new and used vehicle sales.
-Exceeded individual sales goals and customer service goals.
-Identify prospective customers by using business directories and following leads from existing clients.
-Self-motivated sales professionals with inside or outside sales
-Participate in weekly Sales meetings to report on trending and initiatives as well as the review of recommended actions.
-Strong interpersonal and communication skills
-Recommend products to customers, based on customers' needs and interests.
-Estimate or quote prices, credit or contract terms, warranties, and delivery dates
-Consult with clients after sales or contract signings to resolve problems and to provide ongoing support.

positions.title: CSC
positions.description:
-Consistently achieve meet and/or exceed quota.
-Consistently lead store in Customer survey score and performance.
- Provide strong understanding and enthusiasm around technology,
especially around Comcast products and services. Maintain detailed
sales product knowledge, including competitive information.
- Provide superior customer service with all customer interactions.
Evaluate customers' potential product needs and make appropriate
recommendations.
- Utilize retention techniques to proactively retain existing customers
from canceling service.
- Meet or exceed sales quotas in an accountability-based culture.
- Manage store inventory, process equipment transactions, and handle
high volumes of cash and other payment activity with a focus of
maximizing the customer experience.
- Work in a fast paced, high-volume environment and, where applicable,
cover multiple store locations throughout the operating area; may be
asked to travel to other Customer Service Centers to offer additional
support.
- Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work
nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) and overtime as necessary.
- Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

positions.title: Asst. Store Manager
positions.description:
-Lead team to meet and exceed assigned quotas and manage churn.
-Assess individuals and team performance and initiate development plans to narrow competency gaps. 
-Develop, train, motivate, and coach team to produce desired high performance results. 
-Analyze staffing needs of the store and provide hiring and promotion decisions, and initiate disciplinary action, as appropriate. 
-Responsible for financial and sales reporting. 
-Manage cash and inventory levels. 
-Monitor daily sales results and activities to ensure sales, retention, and compliance objectives are met. 
-Maintain and grow existing customer base and reduce customer churn. 
-Ensure customers and prospective customers are treated with the highest levels of courtesy and professionalism. 
-Maintain knowledge of company and current technology services and competitive industry trends. -Construct market reviews to present to upper management quarterly.

positions.title: Area Supervisor
positions.description:
-provide policy guidance to Village supervisors and ride operators and ensure that they are being abided by.
-Supervise Village supervisors and rider operators, developing, assigning tasks, evaluating work, coaching, and disciplining when necessary.
-Ensure staffing budget was being regulated correctly
-Ensure Village supervisors correctly completed scheduling
-Implement, create, enforce, and improve upon current policies.
